notes.title: DEVLOG 01
notes.content:
Hi!

A little update of the project ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42987161/8bc3c20cd5c385bbe0952237a213c05dab17953a.gif[/img]

We have currently completed the key mechanics of the basic 4 types of units:
- soldier
- truck
- tank
- plane (flight mechanics require a few more fixes).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42987161/ba5660df93df9b00d00d94a2ec7ea55547042fb7.gif[/img]

Therefore, we can conduct small skirmishes with the help of these units on the prepared 3 maps.

We also implemented the AI ​​of enemy units. (they're not the smartest yet, but we're working on it :D )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42987161/fcdfb670a6a366b028c145d91809bf34ff956af7.gif[/img]

More info soon!

[url=https://discord.gg/C5KpZ9AEex][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42987161/40dbf40be9c95111e0d16c5041202e75ddb1d3a0.png[/img][/url]
